tracks.title: Caravel Branle
tracks.description: A lively Renaissance dance for recorder, viols, lute, theorbo, tabor, and tambourine, evoking festive first voyages with a bright, period-authentic acoustic sound.
tracks.prompt: Lively Renaissance dance branle in G major at 126 BPM, 4/4. A bright soprano recorder carries a cheerful folk-like dance tune, answered by a consort of viols, a plucked lute and theorbo continuo; a tabor drum and tambourine keep a sturdy outdoor dance pulse. Arrangement: tabor and lute open for two bars, recorders enter with the tune, viols swell underneath, tambourine lifts every offbeat. Mood: confident, festive, first voyages and caravels, colonial age of discovery. Acoustic period instruments only, close-mic'd with a small stone-hall reverb. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drum kit, no electric bass.

tracks.title: Swashbuckler's Gigue
tracks.description: An energetic Baroque gigue in D major with running eighth notes, sparkling harpsichord, and agile violins trading a confident theme. Castanets and natural trumpet bring a bright Spanish-Caribbean flair in a dry, intimate hall.
tracks.prompt: Energetic Baroque gigue in D major at 132 BPM, 4/4 with running eighth notes. Two violins trade a swaggering tune in thirds over a sparkling harpsichord continuo and a walking cello; Spanish castanets click a heel-and-toe rhythm and a natural trumpet answers with a short fanfare. Arrangement: harpsichord and cello lock the gigue pulse, first violin states the tune, second violin joins in thirds, castanets and trumpet enter at the B section. Mood: swashbuckling Spanish Main, treasure fleet, colonial Caribbean, bright and confident. Period Baroque instruments only, dry intimate hall. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drums.

tracks.title: Gilded Minuet
tracks.description: A bright, elegant instrumental minuet in G major for wooden flute, harpsichord, strings, and cello. The music stays warmly buoyant throughout, with a courtly dance feel and a crisp final cadence.
tracks.prompt: Bright, sunny galant minuet in G major at 144 BPM, 3/4, firmly in the major key: the piece opens and closes on a G major chord, uses F-sharp, and never settles into A minor or E minor. A solo wooden flute plays a buoyant courtly dance melody, light violins answer on the after-beats, a walking cello supports the bass and a harpsichord spins delicate broken chords. Arrangement: harpsichord and cello establish a light oom-pah-pah pulse, the flute enters with the minuet tune, violins add off-beat chords, the repeat is ornamented and ends with a crisp G major cadence. Mood: elegant colonial court, gilded ballroom, trading companies, warm, cheerful and buoyant. Period classical instruments, intimate room. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drums, no minor-key lament.

tracks.title: Broadside Hornpipe
tracks.description: A fast, period-instrument hornpipe with a naval battle swagger, driven by fife, fiddles, cello, tabor, tambourine, and timpani. The middle strain briefly darkens in B minor before snapping back to a bright D major finish.
tracks.prompt: Fast buccaneer hornpipe in D major at 152 BPM, 4/4. A bright military fife and two fiddles play a rollicking sailors' dance tune over driving cello eighth notes, tabor, tambourine and timpani accents; the B section slips into B minor for a flash of danger before resolving to D major. Arrangement: tabor and cello start the hornpipe pulse, fife states the tune, fiddles double an octave below, tambourine and timpani drive the chorus. Mood: naval battle at sea, cannon smoke, boarding parties, exciting and adventurous, never spooky. Period instruments only, dry and punchy. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drums.

tracks.title: D Major Triumph
tracks.description: A short, bright Baroque victory fanfare with natural trumpets, timpani rolls, and full strings in a ceremonial small-hall setting. It drives upward with a clean, triumphant ending on a sustained D major chord.
tracks.prompt: Short triumphant Baroque victory fanfare in D major, ceremonial and bright. Natural trumpets lead a rising figure over timpani rolls and full strings, ending on a crisp sustained D major chord. Period instruments, small hall, instrumental only, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drums. Clean decisive ending, no fade out.

tracks.title: Dignified Knell
tracks.description: A brief solemn Baroque-style descent in D minor for period instruments, with low strings, a muted trumpet reply, and a final timpani stroke. Formal and restrained, ending cleanly with no fade out.
tracks.prompt: Short dignified Baroque defeat knell in D minor. Low viols and cello play a slow falling cadence, a muted natural trumpet answers, and a single deep timpani stroke closes the phrase. Somber and formal, not horror or ghostly. Period instruments, church-like room, instrumental only, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drums. Clean ending, no fade out.
